compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Jerusalem’s vessels and youths enter Babylon beside Remnant violence gives way to a lifted captive king; Songs stop by Babylon’s rivers; Cyrus authorizes return and rebuilding; The foundation joins shouting and weeping.
